test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 30 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) in the following series to continue the pattern?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9cac5faedecb7d110c0dd9494219aad48dd74024f13a7ae032f37221ac6bb4ba.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The 1st column elements shift clockwise subsequently.

The 3rd column elements shift anticlockwise subsequently.

The rest of the elements shift anticlockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eaa12d3381f0223885c2eccec81a1d194442a0d0d07dc17e8ffb7481341a6897.png] 

2) Second box series →

The bottom elements and corner elements of 2nd row shift anticlockwise subsequently.

The rest of the elements shift anticlockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07ff7c40a7683bfb6cc943a6c540aa896edf816f4db4c6228a11a6a400c68383.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f39357c65966012878d5dd186523de86451e7939b4a77259028d44d998e1350e.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
